notes.title: Release Day
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Dear Agony Aunt community :)

The development process for Dear Agony Aunt has been a whirlwind of excitement and stress and amazement. I can't believe release day is already here!

If you'd like to read about my experience of making the game, I wrote a post about the Dear Agony Aunt development adventure on my blog:
Faye Strawberry blog

Thank you so much for taking an interest in the game. I hope you enjoy getting to know the characters and trying to convince EF Magazine that you would be a great choice as their new agony aunt!

Faye <3x
